text:
katie-support: FYI customer acme-fin (private VPC) opened a ticket — their console shows empty metrics for tenant `acme-fin` since Friday after the migration. Charts are blank and queries return 403. Ticket #INC-12345. Anyone seen this pattern?

ops-sre: Can you paste an example request + response (headers)? Is it just metrics-service or other console APIs too?

katie-support: Pasting sanitized repro (they ran this from their VPC):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token-redacted>" -H "X-Tenant-ID: acme-fin" "https://metrics.private.redwood/api/v1/query?tenant=acme-fin"
```
Response:
```json
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "forbidden",
  "reason": "tenant not found or unauthorized"
}
```
And from the metrics-service logs: 
```
2024-10-11T14:02:08Z WARN auth: missing tenant header for request from 10.4.5.23
2024-10-11T14:02:08Z ERROR request: auth failed (no tenant mapping) trace=abcd1234
```
They also said inference/serve endpoints work fine — only dashboards/metrics are affected.

raj-engineering: Quick hypothesis: the edge auth-proxy (used in private VPC) strips unknown headers unless the origin request is mTLS-authenticated or explicitly whitelisted. Console-service requests to metrics-service go through the proxy and the `X-Tenant-ID` header is being dropped, so metrics sees no tenant and returns 403. I've seen this exact symptom during early VPC rollouts.

cecilia-support: Confirmed with customer — token scopes are fine, only metrics queries fail.

ops-sre: I can try a canary config to preserve `X-Tenant-ID` for requests between console -> metrics for private subdomain. Can someone run a quick test if I toggle header-preserve on the edge-router?

katie-support: Running test now...
(30s)
katie-support: After ops-sre toggled preserve rule, curl now returns 200 and query payload shows time series. Dashboard started filling in within ~45s. :tada:

raj-engineering: Good catch. Root cause summary: auth-proxy header whitelist didn't include tenant header for private VPC traffic because we gated that feature behind a customer_jwt claim flag (`preserve_headers`) which we didn't set for older private tenants. We'll: 1) add `X-Tenant-ID` to the default whitelist for internal console -> metrics calls; 2) update onboarding to set the claim for existing tenants; 3) add an alert if metrics-service returns repeated 403s for a tenant. I'll open PR and patch tomorrow (PR #2045).

ops-sre: I'll promote the temporary preserve-rule to prod for all private namespaces to buy time. Please add repro steps & logs to INC-12345 and link the PR.

katie-support: Added logs, curl, and before/after screenshots to the ticket. Customer confirmed dashboards back, they're happy for now but requested an RCA and ETA for permanent fix.

director-support: Please include customer impact summary and confirm whether billing/usage vs charts mismatch (they noticed no billing break).

raj-engineering: No billing delta expected since tokens/calls succeeded — only the metrics ingestion path was blocked. I'll include that in the RCA.

deploy-bot: deployment ops/edge-router: promoted canary -> prod at 2024-10-11T14:05:12Z

ops-sre: Follow-ups: automated test that simulates console request through proxy to metrics (verify `X-Tenant-ID` arrives), onboarding docs updated, and alert created. I'll coordinate the rollback window if the permanent change causes unexpected header side-effects.

katie-support: Thanks all — closing the support loop with the customer after we publish RCA.

(attachments: sanitized headers, logs, ticket link INC-12345)
